tagline: KEMANIA: crispy basil-leaf snacks from Setu, including a fish-enhanced variant.

story.title: KEMANIA: crispy basil-leaf snacks from Setu, including a fish-enhanced variant.
story.body: Rumah Kurasi Tangerang Selatan lists Fenda Iriani as the maker of KEMANIA and KEMANIA FISH in Setu. KEMANIA uses basil leaves with mocaf/cassava flour, while KEMANIA FISH combines basil-leaf chips with mackerel. Both curated listings state SPP-IRT and Halal LPPOM MUI.

highlights.body: Basil-leaf snack prepared with mocaf/cassava flour for a crisp, savoury format.
